summary: Khangsar Tenpe Wangchuk (1938–2014) was a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under traditional teachers Jampal Gyepe Dorje and Lodro Gyatso.
Khen Gen Jampal Dorjé studied under Shenphen Nangwa and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso.
A scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies, Khen Rinpoche Ngawang Jinpa studied at Drepung Loseling Monastery and served as a professor at St. Joseph's College, Darjeeling (attested 1995).
Khenchen Ngawang Khyen Rab Gyatso studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and Trulshik Rinpoche.

Khenchen Palden Sherab Rinpoche (1938–2010) worked in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and philosophy. He studied at Gochen and Riwoche monasteries under teachers including Tubten Tsondru and Dudjom Rinpoche, and chaired the Nyingma section at CIHTS (~1967–1984).
Khenchen Tashi Özer studied under Patrul Rinpoche, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, and Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye.

Working in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and philosophy, Khenchen Thrangu Rinpoche (1933–2023) studied under Khenpo Gangshar and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje. He served as abbot at Rumtek Monastery (~1976), Karma Shri Nalanda Institute (~1981), and Gampo Abbey (~1984–2023).
Khenchen Tsewang Rigdzin studied under Shenphen Nangwa, Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, Shechen Gyaltsab, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso.

Khenpo Appey Rinpoche (1927–2010) specialized in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at Dzongsar Monastery under Drakgyab Lodrö, directed Sakya College (1972–1985), and held a post at the Namgyal Institute of Tibetology.
Khenpo Dazer was a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied under Botrul Dongak Tenpai Nyima. He held teaching posts at Śrī Siṃha Shedra and the Ngagyur Nyingma Institute.

Khenpo Gangshar (1925–1980) worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Shechen Monastery under Khyentse Ozer, Shechen Kongtrul, and Karsé Kongtrul, later serving as senior teacher there (~1950–1957) and founding dean at Surmang Monastery (~1957–1959).

Khenpo Jigme Phuntsok (1933–2004) was a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. His teachers included Botrul Dongak Tenpai Nyima, Ba Tur Khenpo Tubten Chö Pel, Yonten Gonpo, and Khenchen Dazer, among others.

Specializing in Buddhist studies and Tibetology, Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche (1924–2019) studied at Thrangu Monastery and under 8th Traleg Rinpoche, Khenpo Gangshar, and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje. He taught at Rumtek Monastery (1967) and became abbot of Karma Triyana Dharmachakra (1978).
Khenpo Konchog Gyaltsen Rinpoche (born 1946) is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under Khunu Lama Tenzin Gyaltsen, Khyunga Rinpoche, and Pachung Rinpoche.
Khenpo Lodrö Dönyö is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied under Kalu Rinpoche (~1970–1989) and Bokar Rinpoche (~1970–2004).

Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang (1879–1941) worked in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under numerous teachers, including Shenphen Nangwa, Kunzang Pelden, Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso, and Tubten Chokyi Dorje.
Khenpo Nüden studied under Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang and Shechen Gyaltsab.
Khenpo Sherab Püntsok studied under Ogyen Trinley Dorje and Khenchen Thrangu Rinpoche.

Khenpo Tsultrim Gyamtso Rinpoche (1934–2024) worked in Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and philosophy. He studied under Lama Zopa Tarchin and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje, serving as principal shedra teacher at Rumtek Monastery (~1977–1986) and spiritual advisor at Pullahari Monastery (1992).

Khetsun Sangpo Rinpoche (1920–2009) worked in Tibetology and Buddhist studies, studying under Jetsun Lochen Rinpoche, Dudjom Rinpoche, and Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche. He held teaching posts at Tokyo and Kyoto universities (1960–1970) and the University of Virginia (~1979–1980).
